style=\"-webkit-text-size-adjust: 100%; caret-color: rgb(117, 117, 117); color: #757575; font-family: Roboto, sans-serif; font-size: 15px;\"\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp style=\"-webkit-text-size-adjust: 100%; caret-color: rgb(117, 117, 117); color: #757575; font-family: Roboto, sans-serif; font-size: 15px;\"\u003E\u003Ca href=\"https:\/\/sudhamshireddy.blogspot.com\/2023\/04\/reddy-this-is-online-e-log-book-to.html\"\u003Ehttps:\/\/sudhamshireddy.blogspot.com\/2023\/04\/reddy-this-is-online-e-log-book-to.html\u003C\/a\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp style=\"-webkit-text-size-adjust: 100%; caret-color: rgb(117, 117, 117); color: #757575; font-family: Roboto, sans-serif; font-size: 15px;\"\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp style=\"-webkit-text-size-adjust: 100%; caret-color: rgb(117, 117, 117); color: #757575; font-family: Roboto, sans-serif; font-size: 15px;\"\u003EUnit duty was a great opportunity to be able to learn how to handle a multitude of patients and about treatment and evaluation of different cases.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp style=\"-webkit-text-size-adjust: 100%; caret-color: rgb(117, 117, 117); color: #757575; font-family: Roboto, sans-serif; font-size: 15px;\"\u003EOur OP days are on Saturdays , and we see around 80-100 cases per day. We were able to learn how to take patient history and do clinical examinations for many patients.\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp style=\"-webkit-text-size-adjust: 100%; caret-color: rgb(117, 117, 117); color: #757575; font-family: Roboto, sans-serif; font-size: 15px;\"\u003EWith the help of our PGs we had the opportunity to look at different clinical cases and do real time application of evaluation and coming to a conclusion about the diagnosis and treatment regimens of the patients.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp style=\"-webkit-text-size-adjust: 100%; caret-color: rgb(117, 117, 117); color: #757575; font-family: Roboto, sans-serif; font-size: 15px;\"\u003ELearned how to interpret different ECGs, 2D ECHO’s, X-rays during evaluation of each case.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp style=\"-webkit-text-size-adjust: 100%; caret-color: rgb(117, 117, 117); color: #757575; font-family: Roboto, sans-serif; font-size: 15px;\"\u003EBy taking patients for referrals I understood the true essence of multisystem problems and the importance of interdepartmental coordination in arriving at a diagnosis and treating the patient.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp style=\"-webkit-text-size-adjust: 100%; caret-color: rgb(117, 117, 117); color: #757575; font-family: Roboto, sans-serif; font-size: 15px;\"\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp style=\"-webkit-text-size-adjust: 100%; caret-color: rgb(117, 117, 117); color: #757575; font-family: Roboto, sans-serif; font-size: 15px;\"\u003E\u003Cb\u003E\u003Cu\u003EWARD ROTATIONS\u003C\/u\u003E\u003C\/b\u003E\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp style=\"-webkit-text-size-adjust: 100%; caret-color: rgb(117, 117, 117); color: #757575; font-family: Roboto, sans-serif; font-size: 15px;\"\u003EI started my peripheral postings with ward rotations. Ward postings were one of my favourite postings, because you get to see patients from all units of general medicine.\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp style=\"-webkit-text-size-adjust: 100%; caret-color: rgb(117, 117, 117); color: #757575; font-family: Roboto, sans-serif; font-size: 15px;\"\u003EDuring my time there, I was able to see different cases in the ICU\/AMC\/Ward that were taken care of my other units and was able to take my own history for some patients.\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp style=\"-webkit-text-size-adjust: 100%; caret-color: rgb(117, 117, 117); color: #757575; font-family: Roboto, sans-serif; font-size: 15px;\"\u003EWard rotations gave me the opportunity to follow up and be in constant touch with my patients with the help of PAJR groups.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp style=\"-webkit-text-size-adjust: 100%; caret-color: rgb(117, 117, 117); color: #757575; font-family: Roboto, sans-serif; font-size: 15px;\"\u003ELearned about constructional apraxia charting, through this I could assess day wise improvement of my patient.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp style=\"-webkit-text-size-adjust: 100%; caret-color: rgb(117, 117, 117); color: #757575; font-family: Roboto, sans-serif; font-size: 15px;\"\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp style=\"-webkit-text-size-adjust: 100%; caret-color: rgb(117, 117, 117); color: #757575; font-family: Roboto, sans-serif; font-size: 15px;\"\u003E\u003Cspan face=\"Roboto, sans-serif\"\u003E\u003Cb\u003E\u003Cu\u003EICU ROTATION\u003C\/u\u003E\u003C\/b\u003E\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp style=\"-webkit-text-size-adjust: 100%; caret-color: rgb(117, 117, 117); color: #757575; font-family: Roboto, sans-serif; font-size: 15px;\"\u003E\u003Cspan face=\"Roboto, sans-serif\"\u003EFollowing ward, I was posted in Intensive care unit(ICU) for 5 days.\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp style=\"-webkit-text-size-adjust: 100%; caret-color: rgb(117, 117, 117); color: #757575; font-family: Roboto, sans-serif; font-size: 15px;\"\u003E\u003Cspan face=\"Roboto, sans-serif\"\u003EIt gave me a first hand experience into critical care and helped me understand the importance and necessity of timely intervention.\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp style=\"-webkit-text-size-adjust: 100%; caret-color: rgb(117, 117, 117); color: #757575; font-family: Roboto, sans-serif; font-size: 15px;\"\u003E\u003Cspan face=\"Roboto, sans-serif\"\u003EEven though the ICU duty only last for a short amount of time, it is an opportunity to learn a lot of clinical skills.\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp style=\"-webkit-text-size-adjust: 100%; caret-color: rgb(117, 117, 117); color: #757575; font-family: Roboto, sans-serif; font-size: 15px;\"\u003E\u003Cspan face=\"Roboto, sans-serif\"\u003EHowever, even though it was initially a struggle, the PGs made it an easy transition, and I was able to learn a lot in my time there.\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp style=\"-webkit-text-size-adjust: 100%; caret-color: rgb(117, 117, 117); color: #757575; font-family: Roboto, sans-serif; font-size: 15px;\"\u003E\u0026nbsp;I got the opportunity to learn how to draw ABG samples, taking around 15 radial and femoral samples as well as drawing regular blood samples for to send as lab samples.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp style=\"-webkit-text-size-adjust: 100%; caret-color: rgb(117, 117, 117); color: #757575; font-family: Roboto, sans-serif; font-size: 15px;\"\u003E\u003Cspan face=\"Roboto, sans-serif\"\u003EI learned how to place a nasogastric (ryles) tube, and was able to place it for 4 patients. I also learned how to insert a foleys catheter for both female and male patients in the ICU.\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp style=\"-webkit-text-size-adjust: 100%; caret-color: rgb(117, 117, 117); color: #757575; font-family: Roboto, sans-serif; font-size: 15px;\"\u003E\u003Cspan face=\"Roboto, sans-serif\"\u003EI was able to assist the PGs with the placement of a central line for a nephrology patient that got shifted to the ICU.\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp style=\"-webkit-text-size-adjust: 100%; caret-color: rgb(117, 117, 117); color: #757575; font-family: Roboto, sans-serif; font-size: 15px;\"\u003E\u003Cspan face=\"Roboto, sans-serif\"\u003EI was able to Assist during active management of a patient who went into cardiac arrest.\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp style=\"-webkit-text-size-adjust: 100%; caret-color: rgb(117, 117, 117); color: #757575; font-family: Roboto, sans-serif; font-size: 15px;\"\u003EDuring my ICU postings we intubated 4 cases and I was able to assist for 2 of them.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp style=\"-webkit-text-size-adjust: 100%; caret-color: rgb(117, 117, 117); color: #757575; font-family: Roboto, sans-serif; font-size: 15px;\"\u003EOne of the cases was a 70 year old male, brain dead, was on ventilator for 4 days. Tracheostomy was done on day 5, I was able to assist and it was my first experience with the procedure. Despite all the above the patient didn’t respond well and succumbed two days later. There was a sudden fall in BP and pulse was not recordable.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp style=\"-webkit-text-size-adjust: 100%; caret-color: rgb(117, 117, 117); color: #757575; font-family: Roboto, sans-serif; font-size: 15px;\"\u003EI monitored patients during blood transfusion and learned about transfusion reactions.\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp style=\"-webkit-text-size-adjust: 100%; caret-color: rgb(117, 117, 117); color: #757575; font-family: Roboto, sans-serif; font-size: 15px;\"\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp style=\"-webkit-text-size-adjust: 100%; caret-color: rgb(117, 117, 117); color: #757575; font-family: Roboto, sans-serif; font-size: 15px;\"\u003E\u003Cb\u003E\u003Cu\u003ENEPHROLOGY ROTATION\u003C\/u\u003E\u003C\/b\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp style=\"-webkit-text-size-adjust: 100%; caret-color: rgb(117, 117, 117); color: #757575; font-family: Roboto, sans-serif; font-size: 15px;\"\u003EAfter ICU, I was placed into nephrology duties for the next five days. Nephrology was by far my most challenging posting, just for the sheer amount of work as well as the condition of the patients.\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp style=\"-webkit-text-size-adjust: 100%; caret-color: rgb(117, 117, 117); color: #757575; font-family: Roboto, sans-serif; font-size: 15px;\"\u003EIn nephrology, we are expected to take care of all the ICU\/AMC nephrology cases and CKD ward patients who are our inpatients, as well as the patients who come daily for maintenance hemodialysis.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp style=\"-webkit-text-size-adjust: 100%; caret-color: rgb(117, 117, 117); color: #757575; font-family: Roboto, sans-serif; font-size: 15px;\"\u003EDuring my nephrology rotation, I monitored 2 PRBC blood transfusions and was able to learn about the use of cross matching samples, figured out donors, and learned about transfusion reactions.\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp style=\"-webkit-text-size-adjust: 100%; caret-color: rgb(117, 117, 117); color: #757575; font-family: Roboto, sans-serif; font-size: 15px;\"\u003EI also assisted Dr Pavan sir in the placement of two central lines.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp style=\"-webkit-text-size-adjust: 100%; caret-color: rgb(117, 117, 117); color: #757575; font-family: Roboto, sans-serif; font-size: 15px;\"\u003EOne of the best opportunities was to sit in for the dialysis sessions and be able to learn how the equipment works and how patients react to hemo dialysis. I monitored around 10 patients in different sessions of hemo dialysis and was able to do vital monitoring, learn about different complications that could arise, the benefits or disadvantages of placing a patient on hemo dialysis etc.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp style=\"-webkit-text-size-adjust: 100%; caret-color: rgb(117, 117, 117); color: #757575; font-family: Roboto, sans-serif; font-size: 15px;\"\u003EIt was a great learning experience, and even though nephrology was an intense posting, I really enjoyed it.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp style=\"-webkit-text-size-adjust: 100%; caret-color: rgb(117, 117, 117); color: #757575; font-family: Roboto, sans-serif; font-size: 15px;\"\u003E\u003Cb\u003E\u003Cu\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/u\u003E\u003C\/b\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp style=\"-webkit-text-size-adjust: 100%; caret-color: rgb(117, 117, 117); color: #757575; font-family: Roboto, sans-serif; font-size: 15px;\"\u003E\u003Cb\u003E\u003Cu\u003EPSYCHIATRY POSTINGS\u003C\/u\u003E\u003C\/b\u003E\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp style=\"-webkit-text-size-adjust: 100%; caret-color: rgb(117, 117, 117); color: #757575; font-family: Roboto, sans-serif; font-size: 15px;\"\u003EI was posted in the department of psychiatry for 15 days.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp style=\"-webkit-text-size-adjust: 100%; caret-color: rgb(117, 117, 117); color: #757575; font-family: Roboto, sans-serif; font-size: 15px;\"\u003EPsychiatry is a subject that I’m very interested in, and it was a great opportunity to be able to look at different cases and watch the PGs evaluate each case, because it’s a different approach than what we’re used to in medicine.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp style=\"-webkit-text-size-adjust: 100%; caret-color: rgb(117, 117, 117); color: #757575; font-family: Roboto, sans-serif; font-size: 15px;\"\u003ESome cases I saw included schizophrenia, panic attacks, depression, bipolar disorder, substance abuse .\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp style=\"-webkit-text-size-adjust: 100%; caret-color: rgb(117, 117, 117); color: #757575; font-family: Roboto, sans-serif; font-size: 15px;\"\u003EWe learnt in detail about classifications of different psychiatric conditions, and the treatment for each case, along with patient compliance and how to follow up different cases.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp style=\"-webkit-text-size-adjust: 100%; caret-color: rgb(117, 117, 117); color: #757575; font-family: Roboto, sans-serif; font-size: 15px;\"\u003EWe also got a chance to observe cases in the deaddiction centre, and see patients undergoing therapy.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp style=\"-webkit-text-size-adjust: 100%; caret-color: rgb(117, 117, 117); color: #757575; font-family: Roboto, sans-serif; font-size: 15px;\"\u003EPsychiatry posting helped me really understand how many people are dealing with mental ill was which otherwise is overlooked.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp style=\"-webkit-text-size-adjust: 100%; caret-color: rgb(117, 117, 117); color: #757575; font-family: Roboto, sans-serif; font-size: 15px;\"\u003EMental health cannot be ignored and I also attended a couple of counselling sessions with my patients wherein we did music therapy, mediation etc..\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp style=\"-webkit-text-size-adjust: 100%; caret-color: rgb(117, 117, 117); color: #757575; font-family: Roboto, sans-serif; font-size: 15px;\"\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp style=\"-webkit-text-size-adjust: 100%; caret-color: rgb(117, 117, 117); color: #757575; font-family: Roboto, sans-serif; font-size: 15px;\"\u003EOverall, the general medicine posting was a great learning experience, and taught me important clinical and social skills that will hopefully help be better evaluate and treat patients in the future.\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp style=\"-webkit-text-size-adjust: 100%;
